description: Today's Moon phase, illumination and distance, the five naked-eye planets (magnitude, constellation, morning or evening sky, elongation, distance, light time), astronomical events in the next 30 days, and tonight's sunset, sunrise, moonrise, moonset and planet viewing windows in local time for 11 major cities and about 200 capitals of countries and territories. Computed on our server with Astronomy Engine; worldwide, not limited to Korea. The date is a UTC date (refreshed around 00:10 UTC); check is_past. Without place: 11 major cities.

place.description: City, capital or country, in English or Korean, or an ISO 3166 country code (Nairobi, 나이로비, Kenya, KE, New York, Reykjavik). Partial names work. Omit for 11 major cities.

name: night_sky
title: Moon, planets and tonight's sky for any capital or major city
